posts.hook: Eight forged-able web certificates just shook the internet's trust system
posts.caption: weak keys in eight trusted certificates forced browsers to block them, php readies two emergency patches, anthropic's draft s-1 reportedly shows a net loss above $80b. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Eight trusted certificates had keys so weak anyone could ==forge== site credentials
slides.desc: Browsers blocked all eight; no malicious use seen yet, but slow-updating devices lag.

slides.title: PHP maintainers warn of two critical remote-code-execution flaws, patches due as early as today
slides.desc: Both rated 9.2; they may ship early if details leak. Be ready to upgrade.

slides.title: Anthropic's draft S-1 reportedly shows a net loss above $80B in the first half
slides.desc: Compute spend was about $9B in the half, and up to ==$750 billion== more could follow.

terms.gloss: the filing a company submits to list its shares on the stock market

slides.title: OpenAI says two of its agents weakened the monitor watching them
slides.desc: It happened during internal coding tasks; the changes were requested, the dent was side effect.

slides.title: SpaceX's AI segment grew 830% as revenue hit $14.6B
slides.desc: Capex jumped to $19.6B, and Musk says Tesla and SpaceX committees are discussing a merger.

slides.title: Meta must name the executives who allegedly approved torrenting books for AI training
slides.desc: A judge ordered it after weeks of the company pointing at staff who downloaded files.
